verdict.rationale: Twilio documents one concrete bulk operation: a single port-in request can cover up to 1,000 US non-toll-free phone numbers. The 'at scale' email claims are vague throughput statements, not a documented bulk-operation API, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general bulk/batch APIs across resources (messages, numbers, recordings), bulk update or delete operations, any documentation of batch endpoints beyond porting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: create a port-in request for US non-toll-free phone numbers (up to 1,000 numbers per request).
